name: era
description: Connect Era to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Era MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Era to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with personal finance using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
